verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own private Status Pages (incident-io-docs-22, incident-io-docs-57). Workflows can auto-publish to a status page when an incident is updated (incident-io-docs-9), and AI drafts structured updates and summaries (incident-io-docs-12, incident-io-docs-53). Together these suggest a way to push structured updates to people outside the incident channel, but the evidence frames status pages around customers and never documents internal stakeholder subscriptions. Missing for 10: an explicit internal stakeholder update feature, a documented subscription mechanism (email or Slack opt-in), evidence that private status pages target internal audiences, and independent corroboration.
